rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone acts with full knowledge of the relevant facts.

example.english: They knowingly drove in even though the road was closed.
example.traditional: 佢明知條路封咗，仲照樣揸車入去。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ming4 zi1 tiu4 lou6 fung1 zo2 zung6 ziu3 joeng2 zaa1 ce1 jap6 heoi3

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is that the action was deliberate or intentional, rather than merely accidental.

example.english: I knowingly ignored the warning and took the shortcut home.
example.traditional: 我特登唔理個警告，行捷徑返屋企。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dak6 dang1 m4 lei5 go3 ging2 gou3 haang4 zit6 ging3 faan1 uk1 kei2

rows.note: Use this for doing something with an unmistakably knowing or fully aware manner, especially a smile or look.

example.english: They smiled at me knowingly, pretending not to know.
example.traditional: 佢心知肚明咁望住我笑，扮晒唔知。
example.jyutping: keoi5 sam1 zi1 tou5 ming4 gam3 mong6 zyu6 ngo5 siu3 baan6 saai3 m4 zi1
